core_obligations: The proof constructs a graded frame map from the Cartan coframing, descends through the faithful reductive quotient to an affine homogeneous space, uses compact torus fibres to force that map to descend to the base, and then constructs the unipotent reduction/flat family. The named BG torus-connection theorem is a prior, but this parametric equivariant-frame/Levi descent remains actual work. The author explicitly says this non-flat torus-fibration result is independent and not used in the main developing-subvariety classification; it is not one of the old ant-foliation fragments.
